'''February 2001 Huntsville tournament (17 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 17 February 2001. [[Andy McClure]] won it. It is known from Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1757">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-cut-off-from-hville-2-17-01d1757/ cut-off-from-hville-2-17-01], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 20 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-cut-off-from-hville-2-17-01d1757/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]
